mechanism: On closed bars only, if high[i]≤high[i−1] and low[i]≥low[i−1], mark the parent (i−1) with UpBuffer=high[i−1] and DownBuffer=low[i−1] (inp_barsTypeSelector=Inside). Captures bars fully contained in prior range as compression/inside-regime events.

mechanism: If high[i]≥high[i−1] and low[i]≤low[i−1], mark the current closed bar with UpBuffer=high[i] and DownBuffer=low[i] (Outside mode). Two-sided range break of prior bar = expansion/breakout-both-ways event. Incremental start = rates_total−barsInPattern after warm-up.

quote: An outside bar is a bar that breaks the range of the previous candlestick in both directions.
